Me almost a month ago:
thedispatch.com/newsletter/g…

Walked the beasts on the mean streets of downtown DC  around 4:45 AM. They are still adjusting.

Video

Well, if … checks notes Pakistan (and other countries not worth naming)  ask us to halt an operation the entire administration insisted was vital and enduring, then obviously we should stop it within 24-48 hours.

This is pretty solid.


Ami Kozak (@amiKozak)

Billie Eilish shared the saga of losing her pet hamster, named Tomato Bisque Soup, in the walls of her bedroom closet for four days. ew.com/billie-eilish-recalls…

A friend of mine texted me this morning “The Met Gala really is the Apex Mountain of douchery.” 

Really hard to argue with.


Oli London (@OliLondonTV)

Sarah Paulson wears dollar bill over her eyes to call out the ‘One Percent.’

The actress, who is worth an estimated $12 million, used her outfit to call out the world’s elite while attending the $100,000 per person Met Gala.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/OliLondonTV/status/2051603573335843110#m
“Good morning. It’s Friday. Don’t be frightened by my collar. It’s for scaring away mean dogs. At least that’s what they told me. Also, I love you.”
I forgot I’ve had an account here since 2023. Kicking the tires now.
Giving this a whirl. This is my first Bluesky post and, yes, I'm tweeting pictures of my dogs. Don't say you weren't warned.
